dynamic_line: Not every demon follows your Brand. Some have crossed the wounds between worlds and roam on their own; the Brand draws another hunt toward you at night. Quieting its call does not remove creatures already near your bed. A closed wound does not silence the Brand.

A keeper holds a particular wound open. When it falls, examine that wound; a victory alone may leave the opening behind. Closing it restrains new crossings nearby. Creatures that have already crossed remain, and distant wounds still feed the dark. Take the evidence with you and read it before choosing another road.

dynamic_line: Choose a place you can leave as well as defend. Dress your wounds, keep drinking water and bandages near your bed, and leave room to reach the door. Light helps you see what is coming; it is not a ward. Rest before testing your strength against an apostle. A weapon cannot give you back the breath spent running.

dynamic_line: Set eight stones and four bones into a protective sign on clear ground. A little wilderness knowledge is enough to arrange it; allow about twenty minutes. Keep your bed within eight steps on the same level. Walls and a clear escape route must do what the sign cannot: shelter you from creatures already here.
